scope: One frozen GPT-2 layer, CPU float64 reference cost-quality study. No long-context, GPU, incremental decode, whole-model quality, certified error, or speedup claim unless separately measured.

selection.rule: Per context, among trained geometry/threshold pairs meeting both validation error limits pooled across all three seeds, choose lowest mean qk_plus_av_vector_work_ratio; ties by geometry ID then threshold. No qualifying pair means no selection. These are layer diagnostics, not semantic quality guarantees.

config.scope: One frozen GPT-2 layer, CPU float64 reference cost-quality study. No long-context, GPU, incremental decode, whole-model quality, certified error, or speedup claim unless separately measured.

peak_rss_scope: Whole capture/fitting/evaluation process high-water mark; not per-configuration inference peak memory.

benchmarks.scope: CPU float64, no quality oracle or detailed trace in timing. Index construction includes ownership copies and hashing. Reuse is a static-snapshot scenario, not growing-cache decode. Tensor bytes exclude caller storage, Python/scratch allocations and process RSS.
